summary: Genius Group Ltd files a Form 6-K announcing a Bitcoin Loyalty Program bonus distribution of $0.10 per share to qualifying shareholders who held shares in book entry from November 29, 2025 to May 28, 2026. The bonus represents a 45.4% premium over the May 27 closing price of $0.22 and is payable in Bitcoin or cash. The company also launches a second round of the program starting June 1, 2026, and will hold an investor presentation on June 2, 2026, to discuss its AI treasury strategy. This event-driven filing involves a shareholder loyalty initiative rather than a change of control, structural transaction, or capital return. The program aims to reduce share lending by long-term holders and provide contact details, with no deal terms applicable.
